first_rows.description:
Three women watch over the bed -- painted by Yetta Balzar, a Pasadena artist whose colors don't apologize — pinks that show up early, oranges that overstay their welcome, reds that refuse to be quiet. They hang above the headboard, a small chorus of muses, and on your first night here you will look up at them and understand what kind of room you're in.

This is a room for people who love color. Who love art. Who believe — correctly — that what hangs above your bed matters.
